course_name_original: UE Management de projet en entreprise

learning_outcomes.text: Provide students with the essentials of project management behaviors and essential techniques.
Better understand and integrate into the corporate world or research thanks to knowledge input and supervised practice of the project mode.

assessment_methods.method: Group project presentation before a jury

assessment_rules: Validation of the work accomplished is done by group, through the presentation of the project before a jury and individually through continuous assessment in the form of a QCM.
institution: Institut National Polytechnique De Grenoble — Licence Électronique-Énergie électrique-Automatique (UGA)
degree: Licence Électronique, énergie électrique, automatique, parcours EEA (2e et 3e année)
